cli.usage:
Usage: grok-companion.mjs <setup|review|adversarial-review|audit|task> [options] [prompt]
Review: --base <ref> --scope <auto|working-tree|branch> --language <tag> --model <model> --cwd <path> --json
Review scopes auto and working-tree require Windows and fail if a complete safe snapshot cannot be collected.
On macOS/Linux, use --scope branch or --base <ref> for committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree. Use audit for the whole repository.
Task: --model <model> --effort <low|medium|high> --cwd <path> --prompt-file <path> --write --json
Each command runs a new foreground Grok session. For resuming, use Grok's own resume command.
cli.disabled: {name} is no longer supported. Use Grok's own commands to resume or manage sessions.
cli.prompt_required: A prompt is required for this Grok run.
cli.unsupported_effort: Unsupported reasoning effort. Use low, medium, or high.
setup.update_grok: Update Grok Build with `grok update`, then run setup again.
setup.install_grok: Install Grok Build with `{command}`, then run setup again.
setup.authenticate: Authenticate with `grok login` (or `grok login --device-auth`), or configure XAI_API_KEY, then run setup again.
diag.usage_exhausted: Grok's usage balance is exhausted (HTTP 402). Retry after the balance recovers.
diag.stop_unconfirmed: Grok agent stop could not be confirmed.
render.stopped_before_result: Review incomplete; Grok stopped before returning a final structured result.
render.invalid_json: Grok did not return valid structured JSON.
render.unexpected_shape: Grok returned JSON with an unexpected review shape.
render.incomplete_notice: Review incomplete; this result must not be treated as approval.
render.no_verified_findings: No verified findings; inspection is incomplete.
